question: What act of sprinkling should the practitioner recollect during this visualization?
premises: The visualized form is associated with milk-water
The form is being sprinkled by all
The practitioner should recollect this sprinkling
inference: One should remember the form as being sprinkled on all sides with milk-water.
uncertainties: The token kṣīrodavi(śe appears incomplete or irregular in the source.
plain_english: One should remember him as being sprinkled on all sides with milk-water.
